title: Interview with Iris
summary: Marcus interviewed Iris, a teacher, in a podcast conversation.

qa_highlights.question: How do you keep a balance?
qa_highlights.answer: Protects Sundays with no messages or screens and a long walk

qa_highlights.question: Who influenced you the most?
qa_highlights.answer: Their first supervisor, who asked better questions instead of giving answers

qa_highlights.question: Which tools do you rely on every day?
qa_highlights.answer: A notebook, a soldering iron and an old spreadsheet

qa_highlights.question: What role does the community play?
qa_highlights.answer: Volunteers found most of the bugs

quotes.speaker: Iris
quotes.text: No messages, no screens, just a long walk.

quotes.speaker: Iris
quotes.text: She never gave answers, she only asked better questions.

quotes.speaker: Iris
quotes.text: The spreadsheet has survived four migrations.

quotes.speaker: Iris
quotes.text: Without them we would still be guessing.
